title: Is Reasoning All You Need? Probing Bias in the Age of Reasoning Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the CLEAR-Bias benchmark via multiple-choice (Choose the Option) and sentence completion tasks. Responses are classified by an LLM-as-a-judge into stereotyped, counter-stereotyped, debiased, or refusal categories under both standard and adversarial jailbreak conditions.
